docstring: Generalized component count bound for $k$-marked stable sphere trees ($k \ge 0$).
signature:
theorem component_count_bounds_marked
    (th : Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
    (u_lim : StableSphereTreeLimit I (M := M)) (B : ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (h_energy : (∑ v : u_lim.tree.V, totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) ≤ B)
    (_h_marked_stable : ∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
      is_ghost_component I u_lim v → 3 ≤ u_lim.tree.adj.degree v + k) :
    let P
goal_type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] {H : Type u_2} [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H]
  (I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M] [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M]
  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (↑⊤) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M] [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (u_lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I) (B : ℝ)
  (k : ℕ),
  ∑ v : u_lim.tree.V, GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v) ≤ B →
    (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V), GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v → 3 ≤ u_lim.tree.adj.degree v + k) →
      let P := Fintype.card { v // GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v };
      let G := Fintype.card { v // GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v };
      ↑P * th.h ≤ B ∧
        (1 < Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V → G ≤ P + k - 2) ∧ ↑(Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) ≤ 1 ⊔ (2 * ⌊B / th.h⌋ + ↑k - 2)
proof:
Fintype.card { v : u_lim.tree.V // is_principal_component I u_lim v }
    let G := Fintype.card { v : u_lim.tree.V // is_ghost_component I u_lim v }
    (P * th.h ≤ B) ∧
    (1 < Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V → G ≤ P + k - 2) ∧
    ((Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V : ℤ) ≤ max 1 (2 * ⌊B / th.h⌋ + (k : ℤ) - 2)) := by
  intro P G
  have h_unmarked := component_count_bounds I th u_lim B h_energy
  refine ⟨h_unmarked.1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h_multi
    have h_g := (h_unmarked.2.1 h_multi).1
    omega
  · by_cases h_multi : 1 < Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V
    · have h_bound := ghost_components_bound I u_lim P G h_multi rfl rfl
      have h_P_le_div : (P : ℝ) ≤ B / th.h := by
        have hP := h_unmarked.1
        rwa [le_div_iff₀ th.h_pos]
      have h_P_le_floor : (P : ℤ) ≤ ⌊B / th.h⌋ := by
        rw [Int.le_floor]
        exact h_P_le_div

name: cp1_coord_two_bounds
docstring: The third coordinate of any point on the unit sphere satisfies $-1 \le z_2 \le 1$.
signature: theorem cp1_coord_two_bounds (z : CP1) : -1 ≤ z.1 2 ∧ z.1 2 ≤ 1
goal_type: ∀ (z : ↑GromovCompactness.CP1), -1 ≤ ↑z 2 ∧ ↑z 2 ≤ 1
proof:
by
  have hz : ‖z.1‖ = 1 := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp z.2
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq] at hz
  have h_pos : 0 ≤ ‖z.1 0‖ ^ 2 + ‖z.1 1‖ ^ 2 + ‖z.1 2‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
  have h_sq := congr_arg (fun x => x^2) hz
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at h_sq
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt h_pos] at h_sq
  have h_norm_sq (x : ℝ) : ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x ^ 2 := by simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  rw [h_norm_sq, h_norm_sq, h_norm_sq] at h_sq
  norm_num at h_sq
  have h_le : (z.1 2)^2 ≤ 1 := by
    have : 0 ≤ (z.1 0)^2 := sq_nonneg _
    have : 0 ≤ (z.1 1)^2 := sq_nonneg _
    linarith
  have h_abs : |z.1 2| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one]
    linarith
  exact abs_le.mp h_abs

  rw [ht_card] at h_div

name: energy_rank_strict_decrease
docstring:
Strict Energy Rank Decrease arithmetic lemma (Contract B06).
If h > 0 and 0 ≤ m_i ≤ m - h, then ⌊m_i / h⌋ < ⌊m / h⌋.
signature:
theorem energy_rank_strict_decrease (m m_i h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (h_pos : 0 ≤ m_i) (hle : m_i ≤ m - h) :
    Nat.floor (m_i / h) < Nat.floor (m / h)
proof:
by
  have h_div : m_i / h ≤ m / h - 1 := by
    calc
      m_i / h ≤ (m - h) / h := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hle hh.le
      _ = m / h - h / h := sub_div m h h
      _ = m / h - 1 := by rw [div_self hh.ne']
  have h_floor_le := Nat.floor_mono h_div
  have h1 : 0 ≤ m / h - 1 := by
    calc
      0 ≤ m_i / h := div_nonneg h_pos hh.le
      _ ≤ m / h - 1 := h_div
  have h_floor_sub : Nat.floor (m / h - 1) < Nat.floor (m / h) := by
    have h_lt : ((Nat.floor (m / h - 1) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ m / h := by
      push_cast
      calc
        (Nat.floor (m / h - 1) : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (m / h - 1) + 1 := by
          have := Nat.floor_le h1
          linarith
        _ = m / h := by ring
    have h_le_floor : Nat.floor (m / h - 1) + 1 ≤ Nat.floor (m / h) :=
      Nat.le_floor h_lt
    exact Nat.lt_of_succ_le h_le_floor
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt h_floor_le h_floor_sub

name: dil_homeo_ne_id
docstring: Dilation homeomorphism is strictly non-identity when $\lambda \ne 1$.
signature:
theorem dil_homeo_ne_id (l : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (hne : l ≠ 1) :
    dil_homeo l hl ≠ Homeomorph.refl CP1
goal_type: ∀ (l : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l), l ≠ 1 → GromovCompactness.dil_homeo l hl ≠ Homeomorph.refl ↑GromovCompactness.CP1
proof:
by
  intro h
  let p : CP1 := ⟨!₂[1, 0, 0], by
    simp only [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm]
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]⟩
  have hp : dil_homeo l hl p = Homeomorph.refl CP1 p := by rw [h]
  have h_coord : (dil_homeo l hl p).1 2 = (Homeomorph.refl CP1 p).1 2 := by rw [hp]
  change (dil_fun l p.1) 2 = p.1 2 at h_coord
  rw [dil_fun_2] at h_coord
  have hp2 : p.1 2 = 0 := rfl
  rw [hp2] at h_coord
  dsimp [D_val] at h_coord
  have h_simp : (1 - l^2 + (1 + l^2) * 0) / (1 + l^2 + (1 - l^2) * 0) = (1 - l^2) / (1 + l^2) := by ring
  rw [h_simp] at h_coord
  have h_pos : 0 < 1 + l^2 := by positivity
  have h_zero : 1 - l^2 = 0 := div_eq_zero_iff.mp h_coord |>.resolve_right (ne_of_gt h_pos)
  have hl_sq : l^2 = 1 := by linarith
  have hl_one : l = 1 := by nlinarith
  exact hne hl_one

lemma OneLevelDecomposition.ghost_branching
    (thresh : TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : ℝ) (base_val : M)
    (decomp : OneLevelDecomposition I thresh m_defect base_val)
    (hm : thresh.h ≤ m_defect)
    (h_const_en : totalEnergy I decomp.v = 0)
    (h_const_disk : energyMeasure I decomp.v (disk_at 0 1) = 0) :
    2 ≤ decomp.q.card
goal_type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] {H : Type u_2} [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H]
  (I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M] [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M]
  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (↑⊤) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M] [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : ℝ) (base_val : M)
  (decomp : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.OneLevelDecomposition I thresh m_defect base_val),
  thresh.h ≤ m_defect →
    GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I decomp.v = 0 →
      GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I decomp.v (GromovCompactness.disk_at 0 1) = 0 → 2 ≤ decomp.q.card
proof:
by
  let q_in := decomp.q.filter (fun w => ‖w‖ < 1)
  let q_out := decomp.q.filter (fun w => ¬ (‖w‖ < 1))
  have h_split : decomp.q = q_in ∪ q_out := by
    ext z
    rw [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_filter]
    constructor
    · intro hz
      by_cases h : ‖z‖ < 1
      · left; exact ⟨hz, h⟩
      · right; exact ⟨hz, h⟩
    · rintro (⟨hz, _⟩ | ⟨hz, _⟩)
      · exact hz
      · exact hz
  have h_disj : Disjoint q_in q_out := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_filter]
    intro x _ hx_in hx_out
    exact hx_out hx_in
  have h_card_split : decomp.q.card = q_in.card + q_out.card := by
    rw [h_split, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint h_disj]
  have h_out_mass := OneLevelDecomposition.ghost_outside_unit_disk_mass I thresh m_defect base_val decomp h_const_en h_const_disk
  have h_out_pos : 0 < thresh.h / 2 := half_pos thresh.h_pos
  have h_q_out_nonempty : q_out.Nonempty := by
    by_contra h_empty
    rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty, not_not] at h_empty
    have h_zero : (∑ z ∈ q_out, decomp.m_child z) = 0 := by
      rw [h_empty, Finset.sum_empty]
    linarith [h_out_mass, h_out_pos, h_zero]
  have h_q_out_card : 0 < q_out.card := h_q_out_nonempty.card_pos
  have h_in_mass : (∑ z ∈ q_in, decomp.m_child z) = m_defect - thresh.h / 2 := by
    have h_calib := decomp.calibrated_unit_mass
    rw [h_const_disk, zero_add] at h_calib
    exact h_calib
  have h_in_pos : 0 < m_defect - thresh.h / 2 := by
    linarith [thresh.h_pos, hm]
  have h_q_in_nonempty : q_in.Nonempty := by
    by_contra h_empty
    rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty, not_not] at h_empty
    have h_zero : (∑ z ∈ q_in, decomp.m_child z) = 0 := by
      rw [h_empty, Finset.sum_empty]
    linarith [h_in_mass, h_in_pos, h_zero]
  have h_q_in_card : 0 < q_in.card := h_q_in_nonempty.card_pos
  linarith [h_card_split, h_q_in_card, h_q_out_card]

name: exp_decay_of_diff_ineq
docstring:
Exponential decay from differential inequality $F(t) \le c \cdot F'(t)$:
If $F : ℝ → ℝ$ is differentiable, $c > 0$, and $F(t) \le c \cdot F'(t)$ for all $t$,
then for any $T \le L$, $F(T) \cdot e^{-T/c} \le F(L) \cdot e^{-L/c}$.
signature:
lemma exp_decay_of_diff_ineq {F : ℝ → ℝ} (hF : Differentiable ℝ F)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (h_ineq : ∀ t, F t ≤ c * deriv F t)
    {T L : ℝ} (hTL : T ≤ L) :
    F T * Real.exp (-T / c) ≤ F L * Real.exp (-L / c)
goal_type:
∀ {F : ℝ → ℝ},
  Differentiable ℝ F →
    ∀ {c : ℝ},
      0 < c → (∀ (t : ℝ), F t ≤ c * deriv F t) → ∀ {T L : ℝ}, T ≤ L → F T * Real.exp (-T / c) ≤ F L * Real.exp (-L / c)
proof:
by
  have hc_ne : c ≠ 0 := hc.ne'
  let g := fun t => F t * Real.exp (-t / c)
  have hg_diff : Differentiable ℝ g := by
    apply Differentiable.mul hF
    apply Differentiable.exp
    apply Differentiable.div_const
    exact differentiable_id.neg
  have hg_deriv : ∀ t, 0 ≤ deriv g t := by
    intro t
    have h_inner : HasDerivAt (fun s => -s / c) (-1 / c) t := by
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s => -s) (-1) t := (hasDerivAt_id t).neg
      have h2 := h1.div_const c
      simpa using h2
    have h_exp := h_inner.exp
    have h_F : HasDerivAt F (deriv F t) t := (hF t).hasDerivAt
    have h_g : HasDerivAt g (deriv F t * Real.exp (-t / c) + F t * (Real.exp (-t / c) * (-1 / c))) t := h_F.mul h_exp
    have hg_eq : deriv g t = (deriv F t - F t / c) * Real.exp (-t / c) := by
      rw [h_g.deriv]
      ring
    rw [hg_eq]
    have h_pos_exp : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-t / c) := (Real.exp_pos _).le
    have h_diff_nonneg : 0 ≤ deriv F t - F t / c := by
      have h1 := h_ineq t
      have h2 : F t / c ≤ deriv F t := by
        have h3 : F t ≤ c * deriv F t := h1
        exact (div_le_iff₀ hc).mpr (by linarith [mul_comm c (deriv F t)])
      linarith
    exact mul_nonneg h_diff_nonneg h_pos_exp
  have h_mono : Monotone g := monotone_of_deriv_nonneg hg_diff hg_deriv
  exact h_mono hTL

When the integral of a non-negative continuous function vanishes on an open ball,
the function vanishes identically on concentric interior balls.
signature:
lemma mvi_branch_zero (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (e : ℂ → ℝ)
    (he_nonneg : ∀ z, 0 ≤ e z)
    (he_cont : ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r))
    (h_int_zero : ∫ w in Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r, e w = 0)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (r / 2)) :
    e z = 0
goal_type:
∀ (r : ℝ),
  0 < r →
    ∀ (e : ℂ → ℝ),
      (∀ (z : ℂ), 0 ≤ e z) →
        ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
          ∫ (w : ℂ) in Metric.ball 0 r, e w = 0 → ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 (r / 2), e z = 0
proof:
by
  have hz_in_ball : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r := by
    rw [mem_closedBall] at hz
    rw [mem_ball]
    linarith
  have h_sub : Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r := ball_subset_closedBall
  have he_cont_ball : ContinuousOn e (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r) := he_cont.mono h_sub
  have he_intble : IntegrableOn e (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r) volume := by
    have h_comp : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r) := isCompact_closedBall 0 r
    have h_intble_closed : IntegrableOn e (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r) volume :=
      he_cont.integrableOn_compact (μ := volume) h_comp
    exact h_intble_closed.mono_set h_sub
  have he_ae_nonneg : 0 ≤ᵐ[volume.restrict (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r)] e := by
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro w
    exact he_nonneg w
  have he_ae_zero : e =ᵐ[volume.restrict (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r)] 0 := by
    rw [← setIntegral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae he_ae_nonneg he_intble]
    exact h_int_zero
  have he_eq : EqOn e 0 (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r) :=
    Measure.eqOn_open_of_ae_eq he_ae_zero isOpen_ball he_cont_ball continuousOn_const
  exact he_eq hz_in_ball

signature:
lemma walk_bridge_count_parity (T₁ T₂ : SphereTree) (v₁ : T₁.V) (v₂ : T₂.V)
    {x y : T₁.V ⊕ T₂.V} (p : (graftAdj T₁ T₂ v₁ v₂).Walk x y) :
    (p.edges.count s(Sum.inl v₁, Sum.inr v₂) : ZMod 2) =
    if isRight T₁ T₂ x = isRight T₁ T₂ y then 0 else 1
goal_type:
∀ (T₁ T₂ : GromovCompactness.SphereTree) (v₁ : T₁.V) (v₂ : T₂.V) {x y : T₁.V ⊕ T₂.V}
  (p : (GromovCompactness.graftAdj T₁ T₂ v₁ v₂).Walk x y),
  ↑(List.count s(Sum.inl v₁, Sum.inr v₂) p.edges) =
    if GromovCompactness.isRight T₁ T₂ x = GromovCompactness.isRight T₁ T₂ y then 0 else 1
proof:
by
  induction p with
  | nil =>
    simp
  | @cons u v w h q ih =>
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.edges_cons, List.count_cons]
    have h_step := isRight_step T₁ T₂ v₁ v₂ h
    push_cast
    rw [ih]
    by_cases he : s(u, v) = s(Sum.inl v₁, Sum.inr v₂)
    · simp only [he, beq_self_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
      have h_diff : isRight T₁ T₂ u ≠ isRight T₁ T₂ v := h_step.mpr he
      rcases hu : isRight T₁ T₂ u <;> rcases hv : isRight T₁ T₂ v <;>
        rcases hw : isRight T₁ T₂ w <;>
        simp_all <;> try decide
    · have h_beq : (s(u, v) == s(Sum.inl v₁, Sum.inr v₂)) = false := by
        simp [beq_iff_eq, he]
      simp only [h_beq, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, add_zero]
      have h_same : isRight T₁ T₂ u = isRight T₁ T₂ v := by
        by_contra h_diff
        exact he (h_step.mp h_diff)
      rw [h_same]

theorem card_le_of_atoms
    (μ : Measure α) (E₀ ε₀ : ℝ) (hE₀ : 0 ≤ E₀) (h_tot : μ univ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal E₀)
    (S : Finset α) (hS : ∀ x ∈ S, ENNReal.ofReal ε₀ ≤ μ {x}) :
    (S.card : ℝ) * ε₀ ≤ E₀
goal_type:
∀ {α : Type u_4} [inst : MeasurableSpace α] [inst_1 : MeasurableSingletonClass α] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α)
  (E₀ ε₀ : ℝ),
  0 ≤ E₀ → μ Set.univ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal E₀ → ∀ (S : Finset α), (∀ x ∈ S, ENNReal.ofReal ε₀ ≤ μ {x}) → ↑S.card * ε₀ ≤ E₀
proof:

  have h_meas : ∀ b ∈ S, MeasurableSet ({b} : Set α) :=
    fun b _ => measurableSet_singleton b
  have h_disj : (S : Set α).PairwiseDisjoint (fun x => ({x} : Set α)) := by
    intro x _ y _ hne
    exact disjoint_singleton.mpr hne
  have h_sum_eq := measure_biUnion_finset h_disj h_meas (μ := μ)
  have h_le_univ : μ (⋃ b ∈ S, ({b} : Set α)) ≤ μ (univ : Set α) :=
    measure_mono (subset_univ _)
  have h_sum_le : (∑ x ∈ S, μ {x}) ≤ μ (univ : Set α) := by
    rw [← h_sum_eq]
    exact h_le_univ
  have h_sum_bound : (∑ x ∈ S, μ {x}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal E₀ :=
    h_sum_le.trans h_tot
  have h1 : ∑ x ∈ S, ENNReal.ofReal ε₀ ≤ ∑ x ∈ S, μ {x} :=
    sum_le_sum (fun x hx => hS x hx)
  rw [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul] at h1
  have h_mul_le := h1.trans h_sum_bound
  have h_rw : (S.card : ENNReal) * ENNReal.ofReal ε₀ = ENNReal.ofReal ((S.card : ℝ) * ε₀) := by
    have h_c : (S.card : ENNReal) = ENNReal.ofReal (S.card : ℝ) := by simp
    rw [h_c, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
  rw [h_rw] at h_mul_le
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff hE₀).mp h_mul_le

    (h_energy : markedTreeTotalEnergy I u_lim ≤ B) :

proof:
Fintype.card { v : u_lim.tree.V // is_principal_component_marked I u_lim v }
    let G := Fintype.card { v : u_lim.tree.V // is_ghost_component_marked I u_lim v }

    ((Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V : ℤ) ≤ max 1 (2 * ⌊B / th.h⌋ + (k : ℤ) - 2)) := by
  intro P G
  let s_prin := Finset.univ.filter (is_principal_component_marked I u_lim)
  have hP : P = s_prin.card := by
    dsimp [P, s_prin]
    rw [Fintype.card_subtype]
  have h_each : ∀ v ∈ s_prin, th.h ≤ totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v) := by
    intro v hv
    have hv_prin : is_principal_component_marked I u_lim v := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2
    have hv_nonconst : ¬ ∃ c : M, ∀ z : CP1, u_lim.map v z = c := hv_prin

  have h_const_sum : ∑ v ∈ s_prin, th.h = (P : ℝ) * th.h := by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hP]

  have h_nonneg : ∀ v : u_lim.tree.V, 0 ≤ totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v) := by
    intro v
    exact energy_nonneg I (u_lim.map v) Set.univ
  have h_sub_le : ∑ v ∈ s_prin, totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v) ≤

    apply Finset.sum_le_univ_sum_of_nonneg
    intro i
    exact h_nonneg i
  have h_P_energy : (P : ℝ) * th.h ≤ B :=
    h_sum_le.trans (h_sub_le.trans h_energy)
  refine ⟨h_P_energy, ?_, ?_⟩

    exact marked_ghost_components_bound I u_lim P G h_multi rfl rfl

      have hG : G = s_ghost.card := by
        dsimp [G, s_ghost]
        rw [Fintype.card_subtype]
      have h_prin_eq : s_prin = Finset.univ.filter (fun v => ¬ is_ghost_component_marked I u_lim v) := by
        ext v
        simp [is_principal_component_marked, s_prin]
      have h_sum_cards : s_ghost.card + s_prin.card = Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V := by
        rw [h_prin_eq, Finset.filter_card_add_filter_neg_card_eq_card, Finset.card_univ]
      have h_V_eq : Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V = G + P := by
        omega
      have h_P_le_div : (P : ℝ) ≤ B / th.h := by
        rwa [le_div_iff₀ th.h_pos]
      have h_P_le_floor : (P : ℤ) ≤ ⌊B / th.h⌋ := by
        rw [Int.le_floor]
        exact h_P_le_div

        have h1 : (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V : ℤ) ≤ 2 * (P : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) - 2 := by omega
        linarith
      exact h_card_le.trans (le_max_right 1 (2 * ⌊B / th.h⌋ + (k : ℤ) - 2))
    · have h_card1 : Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V = 1 := by
        have h_pos : 0 < Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V := Fintype.card_pos
        omega
      rw [h_card1]
      push_cast
      exact le_max_left 1 (2 * ⌊B / th.h⌋ + (k : ℤ) - 2)

  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (↑⊤) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M] [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (u_lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I) (B : ℝ),
  ∑ v : u_lim.tree.V, GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v) ≤ B →
    let P := Fintype.card { v // GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v };
    ↑P * th.h ≤ B
proof:
Fintype.card { v : u_lim.tree.V // is_principal_component I u_lim v }
    P * th.h ≤ B := by
  intro P
  let s_prin := Finset.univ.filter (is_principal_component I u_lim)
  have hP : P = s_prin.card := by
    dsimp [P, s_prin]
    rw [Fintype.card_subtype]
  have h_each : ∀ v ∈ s_prin, th.h ≤ totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v) := by
    intro v hv
    have hv_prin : is_principal_component I u_lim v := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2
    have hv_nonconst : ¬ ∃ c : M, ∀ z : CP1, u_lim.map v z = c := hv_prin
    have h_sph := th.h_sph (u_lim.map v) (u_lim.is_jhol v) hv_nonconst
    exact th.h_le_sph.trans h_sph
  have h_sum_le : ∑ v ∈ s_prin, th.h ≤ ∑ v ∈ s_prin, totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum h_each
  have h_const_sum : ∑ v ∈ s_prin, th.h = (P : ℝ) * th.h := by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hP]
  rw [h_const_sum] at h_sum_le
  have h_nonneg : ∀ v : u_lim.tree.V, 0 ≤ totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v) := by
    intro v
    exact energy_nonneg I (u_lim.map v) Set.univ
  have h_sub_le : ∑ v ∈ s_prin, totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v) ≤
      ∑ v : u_lim.tree.V, totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v) := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_univ_sum_of_nonneg
    intro i
    exact h_nonneg i
  exact h_sum_le.trans (h_sub_le.trans h_energy)

  have h_dec : (1 + l^2) + (1 - l^2) * t = (1 - t) * l^2 + (1 + t) := by ring

  by_cases h : t = -1
  · subst h

    have h1 : 0 < 1 + t := by linarith
    have h2 : 0 ≤ (1 - t) * l^2 := by

docstring: Single-step calibrated Hofer rescaling from Patrick Massot's `hofer` lemma.
signature:
lemma hofer_single_step (ϕ : ℂ → ℝ) (h_cont : Continuous ϕ) (h_nonneg : ∀ y, 0 ≤ ϕ y)
    (x : ℂ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hx_pos : 0 < ϕ x) :
    ∃ (a : ℂ) (lam R : ℝ),
      dist a x ≤ 2 * ε ∧
      0 < lam ∧ 0 < R ∧
      ε * ϕ x ≤ R ∧
      lam * ϕ a = 1 ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, dist z 0 ≤ R → lam * ϕ (a + lam • z) ≤ 2)
goal_type:
∀ (ϕ : ℂ → ℝ),
  Continuous ϕ →
    (∀ (y : ℂ), 0 ≤ ϕ y) →
      ∀ (x : ℂ) (ε : ℝ),
        0 < ε →
          0 < ϕ x →
            ∃ a lam R,
              dist a x ≤ 2 * ε ∧
                0 < lam ∧ 0 < R ∧ ε * ϕ x ≤ R ∧ lam * ϕ a = 1 ∧ ∀ (z : ℂ), dist z 0 ≤ R → lam * ϕ (a + lam • z) ≤ 2
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨ε', hε'_pos, x', _, hx'_dist, h_prod, h_bound⟩ :=
    _root_.hofer x ε hε h_cont h_nonneg
  have h_phi_x'_pos : 0 < ϕ x' := by
    have h_pos_prod : 0 < ε * ϕ x := mul_pos hε hx_pos
    have h_le : ε * ϕ x ≤ ε' * ϕ x' := h_prod
    have h_pos2 : 0 < ε' * ϕ x' := lt_of_lt_of_le h_pos_prod h_le
    by_contra h_neg
    push_neg at h_neg
    have h_mul_nonpos : ε' * ϕ x' ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hε'_pos.le h_neg
    linarith
  let M_val := ϕ x'
  let lam := 1 / M_val
  let R := ε' * M_val
  have hlam_pos : 0 < lam := one_div_pos.mpr h_phi_x'_pos
  have hR_pos : 0 < R := mul_pos hε'_pos h_phi_x'_pos
  have h_prod_eq : lam * R = ε' := by
    dsimp [lam, R, M_val]
    calc
      1 / ϕ x' * (ε' * ϕ x') = (1 / ϕ x' * ϕ x') * ε' := by ring
      _ = 1 * ε' := by rw [one_div_mul_cancel h_phi_x'_pos.ne']
      _ = ε' := by ring
  refine ⟨x', lam, R, hx'_dist, hlam_pos, hR_pos, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp [R]
    exact h_prod
  · dsimp [lam, M_val]
    exact one_div_mul_cancel h_phi_x'_pos.ne'
  · intro z hz
    have h_pos : 0 ≤ lam := hlam_pos.le
    have h_in : dist x' (x' + lam • z) ≤ ε' := by
      rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg h_pos]
      rw [dist_zero_right] at hz
      calc
        lam * ‖z‖ ≤ lam * R := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz h_pos
        _ = ε' := h_prod_eq
    have h_le := h_bound (x' + lam • z) h_in
    calc
      lam * ϕ (x' + lam • z) ≤ lam * (2 * M_val) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_le h_pos
      _ = (lam * M_val) * 2 := by ring
      _ = 1 * 2 := by
        dsimp [lam, M_val]
        rw [one_div_mul_cancel h_phi_x'_pos.ne']
      _ = 2 := by ring

    (h : stableMapEquiv I u₁ u₂) : stableMapEquiv I u₂ u₁
goal_type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] {H : Type u_2} [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H]
  (I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M] [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M]
  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (↑⊤) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M] [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {k : ℕ}
  {u₁ u₂ : GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedStableMap I k},
  GromovCompactness.Extensions.stableMapEquiv I u₁ u₂ → GromovCompactness.Extensions.stableMapEquiv I u₂ u₁
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨iso⟩ := h
  refine ⟨{
    v_equiv := iso.v_equiv.symm
    adj_compat := fun u v => by
      have h_adj := (iso.adj_compat (iso.v_equiv.symm u) (iso.v_equiv.symm v)).symm
      rw [iso.v_equiv.apply_symm_apply u, iso.v_equiv.apply_symm_apply v] at h_adj
      exact h_adj
    moeb := fun v => MoebiusFrame.inv (iso.moeb (iso.v_equiv.symm v))
    node_compat := fun v w h_adj => by
      dsimp [MoebiusFrame.inv]
      obtain ⟨v', rfl⟩ := iso.v_equiv.surjective v
      obtain ⟨w', rfl⟩ := iso.v_equiv.surjective w
      simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      have h_orig_adj : u₁.tree.adj.Adj v' w' := (iso.adj_compat v' w').mpr h_adj
      have h_node := iso.node_compat v' w' h_orig_adj
      rw [← h_node, (iso.moeb v').toHomeo.symm_apply_apply]
    mark_vertex_compat := fun i => by
      have h_mv := iso.mark_vertex_compat i
      exact iso.v_equiv.symm_apply_eq.mpr h_mv.symm
    mark_point_compat := fun i => by
      dsimp [MoebiusFrame.inv]
      have h_mv : iso.v_equiv.symm (u₂.tree.mark_vertex i) = u₁.tree.mark_vertex i := by
        exact iso.v_equiv.symm_apply_eq.mpr (iso.mark_vertex_compat i).symm
      rw [h_mv]
      have h_mp := iso.mark_point_compat i
      rw [← h_mp, (iso.moeb (u₁.tree.mark_vertex i)).toHomeo.symm_apply_apply]
    map_compat := fun v z => by
      dsimp [MoebiusFrame.inv]
      have h_map := iso.map_compat (iso.v_equiv.symm v) ((iso.moeb (iso.v_equiv.symm v)).toHomeo.symm z)
      rw [iso.v_equiv.apply_symm_apply v] at h_map
      rw [(iso.moeb (iso.v_equiv.symm v)).toHomeo.apply_symm_apply z] at h_map
      exact h_map.symm
  }⟩

  linarith

  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (↑⊤) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M] {E_dom : Type u_4} [inst_7 : NormedAddCommGroup E_dom]
  [inst_8 : NormedSpace ℝ E_dom] {H_dom : Type u_5} [inst_9 : TopologicalSpace H_dom]
  (I_dom : ModelWithCorners ℝ E_dom H_dom) {«Σ» : Type u_6} [inst_10 : TopologicalSpace «Σ»]
  [inst_11 : ChartedSpace H_dom «Σ»] [inst_12 : IsManifold I_dom (↑⊤) «Σ»]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [dom : GromovCompactness.RiemannDomain E_dom H_dom I_dom «Σ»]

    ∀ (ψ : «Σ» ≃ₜ «Σ»),

        (∀ (z : «Σ») (v : TangentSpace I_dom z),
            (mfderiv I_dom I_dom (⇑ψ) z) ((GromovCompactness.RiemannDomain.j z) v) =
              (GromovCompactness.RiemannDomain.j (ψ z)) ((mfderiv I_dom I_dom (⇑ψ) z) v)) →

    (∀ (n : ℕ), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Ω) →

  · exact core.1
  · intro z hz v
    have hK_cpt : IsCompact ({z} : Set CP1) := isCompact_singleton
    have hK_sub : ({z} : Set CP1) ⊆ Ω := singleton_subset_iff.mpr hz

lemma graft_degree_bridge_right (T₁ T₂ : SphereTree) (v₁ : T₁.V) (v₂ : T₂.V) :
    T₂.adj.degree v₂ + 1 ≤ (graftAdj T₁ T₂ v₁ v₂).degree (Sum.inr v₂)
goal_type:
∀ (T₁ T₂ : GromovCompactness.SphereTree) (v₁ : T₁.V) (v₂ : T₂.V),
  T₂.adj.degree v₂ + 1 ≤ (GromovCompactness.graftAdj T₁ T₂ v₁ v₂).degree (Sum.inr v₂)
proof:
by
  have h_inj : Function.Injective (Sum.inr : T₂.V → T₁.V ⊕ T₂.V) := Sum.inr_injective
  let s_old := (T₂.adj.neighborFinset v₂).map ⟨Sum.inr, h_inj⟩
  have h_not_mem : Sum.inl v₁ ∉ s_old := by
    intro h_in
    rw [Finset.mem_map] at h_in
    rcases h_in with ⟨w, _, hw⟩
    contradiction
  have h_bridge : (graftAdj T₁ T₂ v₁ v₂).Adj (Sum.inr v₂) (Sum.inl v₁) :=
    (graftAdj T₁ T₂ v₁ v₂).symm (graftAdj_bridge T₁ T₂ v₁ v₂)
  have h_sub : insert (Sum.inl v₁) s_old ⊆ (graftAdj T₁ T₂ v₁ v₂).neighborFinset (Sum.inr v₂) := by
    rw [Finset.insert_subset_iff]
    constructor
    · rw [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]
      exact h_bridge
    · intro x hx
      rw [Finset.mem_map] at hx
      rcases hx with ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      rw [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset] at hw ⊢
      exact hw
  have h_card := Finset.card_le_card h_sub
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_not_mem h_not_mem, Finset.card_map] at h_card
  exact h_card

theorem moebius_three_points_unique (M₁ M₂ : MoebiusMatrix)
    (v₁ v₂ v₃ w₁ w₂ w₃ : ℂ × ℂ)
    (hv12 : ¬ ProjEquiv v₁ v₂) (hv23 : ¬ ProjEquiv v₂ v₃) (hv13 : ¬ ProjEquiv v₁ v₃)
    (hw12 : ¬ ProjEquiv w₁ w₂) (hw23 : ¬ ProjEquiv w₂ w₃) (hw13 : ¬ ProjEquiv w₁ w₃)
    (hM1_1 : ProjEquiv (M₁.act v₁) w₁)
    (hM1_2 : ProjEquiv (M₁.act v₂) w₂)
    (hM1_3 : ProjEquiv (M₁.act v₃) w₃)
    (hM2_1 : ProjEquiv (M₂.act v₁) w₁)
    (hM2_2 : ProjEquiv (M₂.act v₂) w₂)
    (hM2_3 : ProjEquiv (M₂.act v₃) w₃) :

    ¬GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv v₂ v₃ →
      ¬GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv v₁ v₃ →
        ¬GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv w₁ w₂ →
          ¬GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv w₂ w₃ →
            ¬GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv w₁ w₃ →
              GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv (M₁.act v₁) w₁ →
                GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv (M₁.act v₂) w₂ →
                  GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv (M₁.act v₃) w₃ →
                    GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv (M₂.act v₁) w₁ →
                      GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv (M₂.act v₂) w₂ →
                        GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv (M₂.act v₃) w₃ → GromovCompactness.PglEquiv M₁ M₂

  have hw2 : w₂ ≠ (0, 0) := ne_zero_of_not_projEquiv hw23
  have hw3 : w₃ ≠ (0, 0) := ne_zero_of_not_projEquiv (fun h => hw13 (ProjEquiv.symm h))
  have hAw1 : ProjEquiv (A.act (1, 0)) w₁ := act_mul_frame_w1 M₁ v₁ v₂ v₃ w₁ hv12 hv23 hv13 hM1_1
  have hBw1 : ProjEquiv (B.act (1, 0)) w₁ := act_mul_frame_w1 M₂ v₁ v₂ v₃ w₁ hv12 hv23 hv13 hM2_1
  have hT0 : ProjEquiv (T.act (1, 0)) (1, 0) := adj_mul_act_standard_1 A B w₁ hw1 hAw1 hBw1
  have hAw2 : ProjEquiv (A.act (0, 1)) w₂ := act_mul_frame_w2 M₁ v₁ v₂ v₃ w₂ hv12 hv23 hv13 hM1_2
  have hBw2 : ProjEquiv (B.act (0, 1)) w₂ := act_mul_frame_w2 M₂ v₁ v₂ v₃ w₂ hv12 hv23 hv13 hM2_2
  have hT1 : ProjEquiv (T.act (0, 1)) (0, 1) := adj_mul_act_standard_2 A B w₂ hw2 hAw2 hBw2
  have hAw3 : ProjEquiv (A.act (1, 1)) w₃ := act_mul_frame_w3 M₁ v₁ v₂ v₃ w₃ hv12 hv23 hv13 hM1_3
  have hBw3 : ProjEquiv (B.act (1, 1)) w₃ := act_mul_frame_w3 M₂ v₁ v₂ v₃ w₃ hv12 hv23 hv13 hM2_3
  have hTinf : ProjEquiv (T.act (1, 1)) (1, 1) := adj_mul_act_standard_3 A B w₃ hw3 hAw3 hBw3
  have hT_fix : ∀ q, ProjEquiv (T.act q) q := moebius_fix_three_standard T hT0 hT1 hTinf
  intro p
  apply projEquiv_of_frame_action M₁ M₂ F p
  have hTq := hT_fix (F.adj.act p)
  exact (projEquiv_adj_mul_iff A B (F.adj.act p)).mp hTq

name: child_mass_le_parent_sub_h
docstring: In any one-level decomposition, every child defect mass is bounded by m - h (Contract B06).
signature:
theorem child_mass_le_parent_sub_h
    (thresh : TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : ℝ) (base_val : M)
    (decomp : OneLevelDecomposition I thresh m_defect base_val)
    (hm : thresh.h ≤ m_defect) (z : ℂ) (hz : z ∈ decomp.q) :
    decomp.m_child z ≤ m_defect - thresh.h
goal_type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] {H : Type u_2} [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H]
  (I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M] [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M]
  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (↑⊤) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M] [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : ℝ) (base_val : M)
  (decomp : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.OneLevelDecomposition I thresh m_defect base_val),
  thresh.h ≤ m_defect → ∀ z ∈ decomp.q, decomp.m_child z ≤ m_defect - thresh.h
proof:
by
  have h_nonneg : ∀ x ∈ decomp.q, 0 ≤ decomp.m_child x := fun x hx =>
    (thresh.h_pos.trans_le (decomp.m_child_pos x hx)).le
  by_cases h_const : ∃ c : M, ∀ w, decomp.v w = c
  · have h_card := ghost_component_branches_of_const I thresh m_defect base_val decomp hm h_const
    have h_ex_ne : ∃ w ∈ decomp.q, w ≠ z := by
      by_contra h_all
      push_neg at h_all
      have h_sub : decomp.q ⊆ {z} := fun w hw => Finset.mem_singleton.mpr (h_all w hw)
      have h_card_le : decomp.q.card ≤ 1 := (Finset.card_le_card h_sub).trans_eq (Finset.card_singleton z)
      omega
    rcases h_ex_ne with ⟨w, hw, hwz⟩
    have hw_mem_erase : w ∈ decomp.q.erase z := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hwz, hw⟩
    have h_decomp_erase : decomp.q = insert z (decomp.q.erase z) := (Finset.insert_erase hz).symm
    have hz_not_erase : z ∉ decomp.q.erase z := Finset.not_mem_erase z decomp.q
    have h_sum_split : (∑ x ∈ decomp.q, decomp.m_child x) =
        decomp.m_child z + ∑ x ∈ decomp.q.erase z, decomp.m_child x := by
      nth_rw 1 [h_decomp_erase]
      rw [Finset.sum_insert hz_not_erase]
    have h_w_le_sum : decomp.m_child w ≤ ∑ x ∈ decomp.q.erase z, decomp.m_child x :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun x hx => h_nonneg x (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hx)) hw_mem_erase
    have h_h_le_w : thresh.h ≤ decomp.m_child w := decomp.m_child_pos w hw
    have h_h_le_erase : thresh.h ≤ ∑ x ∈ decomp.q.erase z, decomp.m_child x :=
      h_h_le_w.trans h_w_le_sum
    have h_sum_le_m : (∑ x ∈ decomp.q, decomp.m_child x) ≤ m_defect :=
      OneLevelDecomposition.child_mass_sum_le I thresh m_defect base_val decomp
    linarith [h_sum_split, h_h_le_erase, h_sum_le_m]
  · have h_en_sph : thresh.ε_sph ≤ totalEnergy I decomp.v :=
      thresh.h_sph decomp.v decomp.v_jhol h_const
    have h_h_le_en : thresh.h ≤ totalEnergy I decomp.v := thresh.h_le_sph.trans h_en_sph
    have h_z_le_sum : decomp.m_child z ≤ ∑ x ∈ decomp.q, decomp.m_child x :=
      Finset.single_le_sum h_nonneg hz
    have h_ms := decomp.mass_sum
    linarith [h_h_le_en, h_z_le_sum, h_ms]

docstring:
**Universal Component Count Bounds (Contract G04 & Theorem 1)**.
For any stable sphere tree limit of total energy $\le B$:
1. $P \cdot h \le B$, so $P \le \lfloor B / h \rfloor$.
2. If $|V| > 1$, then $G \le P - 2$ and $|V| \le 2P - 2$.
3. Universally across all configurations (including single curves $|V| = 1$), the safe integer bound
   $$(|V| : \mathbb{Z}) \le \max(1, 2\lfloor B / h \rfloor - 2)$$
   holds without natural subtraction truncation artifacts.

    let P := Fintype.card { v // GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v };
    let G := Fintype.card { v // GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v };

      (1 < Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V → G + 2 ≤ P ∧ Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V + 2 ≤ 2 * P) ∧

    ((Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V : ℤ) ≤ max 1 (2 * ⌊B / th.h⌋ - 2)) := by
  intro P G
  have h_energy_bound : (P : ℝ) * th.h ≤ B :=

  refine ⟨h_energy_bound, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h_multi

    · omega
    · omega

    · have h_bound := ghost_components_bound I u_lim P G h_multi rfl rfl
      have h_card_le : (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V : ℤ) ≤ 2 * (P : ℤ) - 2 := by

        rwa [le_div_iff₀ th.h_pos]
      have h_P_le_floor : (P : ℤ) ≤ ⌊B / th.h⌋ := by
        rw [Int.le_floor]
        exact h_P_le_div
      have h_card_le_floor : (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V : ℤ) ≤ 2 * ⌊B / th.h⌋ - 2 := by

name: ghost_components_bound
docstring:
The Ghost Component Bound Theorem (`gromov_compactness.pdf` Theorem 1 & Task `F06`):
In any stable sphere tree with $|V| > 1$, let $P$ be the number of non-constant components
and $G$ be the number of ghost components ($|V| = P + G$).
For unmarked curves ($k = 0$):
1. $G \le P - 2$
2. $|V| = P + G \le 2P - 2$.
In particular, the total number of components is linearly bounded by the number of non-constant components.
(For general $k$-marked curves, $G \le P + k - 2$ and $|V| \le \max(1, 2P + k - 2) \le \max(1, 2\lfloor B/h \rfloor + k - 2)$).
signature:
theorem ghost_components_bound
    (lim : StableSphereTreeLimit I (M := M))
    (P G : ℕ)
    (h_multivertex : 1 < Fintype.card lim.tree.V)
    (h_P : P = Fintype.card { v : lim.tree.V // is_principal_component I lim v })
    (h_G : G = Fintype.card { v : lim.tree.V // is_ghost_component I lim v }) :
    G ≤ P - 2 ∧ Fintype.card lim.tree.V ≤ 2 * P - 2
goal_type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] {H : Type u_2} [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H]
  (I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M] [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M]
  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (↑⊤) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M] [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I) (P G : ℕ),
  1 < Fintype.card lim.tree.V →
    P = Fintype.card { v // GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I lim v } →
      G = Fintype.card { v // GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I lim v } →
        G ≤ P - 2 ∧ Fintype.card lim.tree.V ≤ 2 * P - 2
proof:
by
  have h_card_G : G = (Finset.univ.filter (is_ghost_component I lim)).card := by
    rw [h_G, Fintype.card_subtype]
  have h_card_P : P = (Finset.univ.filter (is_principal_component I lim)).card := by
    rw [h_P, Fintype.card_subtype]
  have h_prin_eq : Finset.univ.filter (is_principal_component I lim) =
      Finset.univ.filter (fun v => ¬ is_ghost_component I lim v) := by
    ext v
    simp [is_principal_component]
  have h_sum_cards : (Finset.univ.filter (is_ghost_component I lim)).card +
      (Finset.univ.filter (is_principal_component I lim)).card = Fintype.card lim.tree.V := by
    rw [h_prin_eq, Finset.filter_card_add_filter_neg_card_eq_card, Finset.card_univ]
  have h_V_eq : Fintype.card lim.tree.V = G + P := by
    rw [h_card_G, h_card_P, h_sum_cards]
  have h_split := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (s := (Finset.univ : Finset lim.tree.V))
    (p := is_ghost_component I lim) (f := fun v => lim.tree.adj.degree v)
  have h_split_sum : ∑ v : lim.tree.V, lim.tree.adj.degree v =
      (∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.filter (is_ghost_component I lim), lim.tree.adj.degree v) +
      (∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.filter (is_principal_component I lim), lim.tree.adj.degree v) := by
    rw [h_prin_eq]
    exact h_split.symm
  have h_ghost_bound : 3 * G ≤ ∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.filter (is_ghost_component I lim), lim.tree.adj.degree v := by
    have h_le : ∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.filter (is_ghost_component I lim), (3 : ℕ) ≤
        ∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.filter (is_ghost_component I lim), lim.tree.adj.degree v := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro v hv
      have hv_ghost : is_ghost_component I lim v := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2
      exact lim.stable v hv_ghost
    have h_const : (∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.filter (is_ghost_component I lim), (3 : ℕ)) =
        3 * (Finset.univ.filter (is_ghost_component I lim)).card := by
      simp [Finset.sum_const, mul_comm]
    omega
  have h_prin_bound : P ≤ ∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.filter (is_principal_component I lim), lim.tree.adj.degree v := by
    have h_le : ∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.filter (is_principal_component I lim), (1 : ℕ) ≤
        ∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.filter (is_principal_component I lim), lim.tree.adj.degree v := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro v _
      exact tree_degree_ge_one lim.tree h_multivertex v
    have h_const : (∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.filter (is_principal_component I lim), (1 : ℕ)) =
        (Finset.univ.filter (is_principal_component I lim)).card := by
      simp [Finset.sum_const]
    omega
  have h_deg_sum := tree_degree_sum lim.tree
  omega

goal_type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] {H : Type u_2} [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H]
  (I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M] [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M]
  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (↑⊤) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M] [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {k : ℕ}
  {u₁ u₂ u₃ : GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedStableMap I k},
  GromovCompactness.Extensions.stableMapEquiv I u₁ u₂ →
    GromovCompactness.Extensions.stableMapEquiv I u₂ u₃ → GromovCompactness.Extensions.stableMapEquiv I u₁ u₃
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨iso12⟩ := h₁₂
  obtain ⟨iso23⟩ := h₂₃
  refine ⟨{
    v_equiv := iso12.v_equiv.trans iso23.v_equiv
    adj_compat := fun u v =>
      (iso12.adj_compat u v).trans (iso23.adj_compat (iso12.v_equiv u) (iso12.v_equiv v))
    moeb := fun v => MoebiusFrame.comp (iso23.moeb (iso12.v_equiv v)) (iso12.moeb v)
    node_compat := fun v w h => by
      dsimp [MoebiusFrame.comp]
      have h1 := iso12.node_compat v w h
      have h2 := iso23.node_compat (iso12.v_equiv v) (iso12.v_equiv w) ((iso12.adj_compat v w).mp h)
      rw [h1, h2]
    mark_vertex_compat := fun i => by
      dsimp [Equiv.trans]
      rw [iso12.mark_vertex_compat i, iso23.mark_vertex_compat i]
    mark_point_compat := fun i => by
      dsimp [MoebiusFrame.comp]
      rw [iso12.mark_vertex_compat i]
      rw [iso12.mark_point_compat i, iso23.mark_point_compat i]
    map_compat := fun v z => by
      dsimp [MoebiusFrame.comp, Equiv.trans]
      have h2 := iso23.map_compat (iso12.v_equiv v) ((iso12.moeb v).toHomeo z)
      have h1 := iso12.map_compat v z
      rw [h2, h1]
  }⟩

signature:
lemma constant_map_sobolev_seminorm_mono (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (r R : ℝ) (hrR : r ≤ R) (c : ℂ) :
    sobolevSeminorm p 0 (fun _ => c) (closedBall (0 : ℂ) r) ≤
    sobolevSeminorm p 0 (fun _ => c) (closedBall (0 : ℂ) R)
goal_type:
∀ (p : ℝ),
  0 < p →
    ∀ (r R : ℝ),
      r ≤ R →
        ∀ (c : ℂ),
          GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevSeminorm p 0 (fun x => c) (Metric.closedBall 0 r) ≤
            GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevSeminorm p 0 (fun x => c) (Metric.closedBall 0 R)
proof:
by
  dsimp [sobolevSeminorm]
  have h_norm : (fun z : ℂ => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (fun _ : ℂ => c) z‖ ^ p) = fun _ => ‖c‖ ^ p := by
    ext z
    simp [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]
  rw [h_norm]
  have hfi : IntegrableOn (fun _ : ℂ => ‖c‖ ^ p) (closedBall (0 : ℂ) R) volume :=
    integrableOn_const.2 (Or.inr measure_closedBall_lt_top)
  have hf : 0 ≤ᵐ[volume.restrict (closedBall (0 : ℂ) R)] (fun _ : ℂ => ‖c‖ ^ p) :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg c) p)
  have hst : closedBall (0 : ℂ) r ≤ᵐ[volume] closedBall (0 : ℂ) R :=
    HasSubset.Subset.eventuallyLE (closedBall_subset_closedBall hrR)
  have h_int_le := setIntegral_mono_set hfi hf hst
  have h_int_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ z in closedBall (0 : ℂ) r, ‖c‖ ^ p := by
    apply setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_closedBall
    intro z _
    exact Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg c) p
  exact Real.rpow_le_rpow h_int_nonneg h_int_le (one_div_nonneg.mpr hp.le)

theorem constant_map_morrey_embedding (p : ℝ) (_hp : 2 < p) (r : ℝ) (_hr : 0 < r) (c : ℂ) :
    ∀ z ∈ closedBall (0 : ℂ) r,
    ∀ w ∈ closedBall (0 : ℂ) r,
      ‖(fun _ : ℂ => c) z - (fun _ : ℂ => c) w‖ ≤
        1 * (dist z w)^(1 - 2 / p) * sobolevNorm p 1 (fun _ => c) (closedBall (0 : ℂ) r)
goal_type:
∀ (p : ℝ),
  2 < p →
    ∀ (r : ℝ),
      0 < r →
        ∀ (c z : ℂ),
          z ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 r →
            ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 r,
              ‖(fun x => c) z - (fun x => c) w‖ ≤
                1 * dist z w ^ (1 - 2 / p) *
                  GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p 1 (fun x => c) (Metric.closedBall 0 r)
proof:
by
  intro z _ w _
  simp only [sub_self, norm_zero]
  have h1 : 0 ≤ (1 : ℝ) := by norm_num
  have h2 : 0 ≤ (dist z w) ^ (1 - 2 / p) := Real.rpow_nonneg dist_nonneg (1 - 2 / p)
  have h3 : 0 ≤ sobolevNorm p 1 (fun _ => c) (closedBall (0 : ℂ) r) :=
    sobolevNorm_nonneg p 1 (fun _ => c) (closedBall (0 : ℂ) r) measurableSet_closedBall
  have h_prod : 0 ≤ 1 * (dist z w) ^ (1 - 2 / p) * sobolevNorm p 1 (fun _ => c) (closedBall (0 : ℂ) r) := by
    apply mul_nonneg
    · exact mul_nonneg h1 h2
    · exact h3
  exact h_prod

In any marked stable sphere tree with $|V| > 1$, $G \le P + k - 2$ (Kernel-verified).

    (u_lim : MarkedStableTreeLimit I (M := M) k)
    (P G : ℕ)
    (h_multi : 1 < Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V)
    (hP : P = Fintype.card { v : u_lim.tree.V // is_principal_component_marked I u_lim v })
    (hG : G = Fintype.card { v : u_lim.tree.V // is_ghost_component_marked I u_lim v }) :
    G ≤ P + k - 2

∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] {H : Type u_2} [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H]
  (I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M] [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M]
  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (↑⊤) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M] [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {k : ℕ}
  (u_lim : GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedStableTreeLimit I k) (P G : ℕ),
  1 < Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V →
    P = Fintype.card { v // GromovCompactness.Extensions.is_principal_component_marked I u_lim v } →
      G = Fintype.card { v // GromovCompactness.Extensions.is_ghost_component_marked I u_lim v } → G ≤ P + k - 2

by
  let s_prin := Finset.univ.filter (is_principal_component_marked I u_lim)
  let s_ghost := Finset.univ.filter (is_ghost_component_marked I u_lim)
  have hP' : P = s_prin.card := by rw [hP, Fintype.card_subtype]
  have hG' : G = s_ghost.card := by rw [hG, Fintype.card_subtype]
  have h_prin_eq : s_prin = Finset.univ.filter (fun v => ¬ is_ghost_component_marked I u_lim v) := by
    ext v
    simp [is_principal_component_marked, s_prin]
  have h_sum_cards : s_ghost.card + s_prin.card = Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V := by
    rw [h_prin_eq, Finset.filter_card_add_filter_neg_card_eq_card, Finset.card_univ]
  have h_V_eq : Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V = G + P := by
    omega
  have h_split := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (s := (Finset.univ : Finset u_lim.tree.V))
    (p := is_ghost_component_marked I u_lim) (f := fun v => u_lim.tree.adj.degree v)
  have h_split_sum : ∑ v : u_lim.tree.V, u_lim.tree.adj.degree v =
      (∑ v ∈ s_ghost, u_lim.tree.adj.degree v) +
      (∑ v ∈ s_prin, u_lim.tree.adj.degree v) := by
    rw [h_prin_eq]
    exact h_split.symm
  have h_deg_sum := tree_degree_sum u_lim.tree
  have h_prin_bound : P ≤ ∑ v ∈ s_prin, u_lim.tree.adj.degree v := by
    have h_le : ∑ v ∈ s_prin, (1 : ℕ) ≤ ∑ v ∈ s_prin, u_lim.tree.adj.degree v := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro v _
      exact tree_degree_ge_one u_lim.tree h_multi v
    have h_const : (∑ v ∈ s_prin, (1 : ℕ)) = s_prin.card := by
      simp [Finset.sum_const]
    omega
  have h_stab_le : 3 * G ≤ ∑ v ∈ s_ghost, (u_lim.tree.adj.degree v + Fintype.card { i : Fin k // u_lim.mark_vertex i = v }) := by
    have h_each_stab : ∀ v ∈ s_ghost, 3 ≤ u_lim.tree.adj.degree v + Fintype.card { i : Fin k // u_lim.mark_vertex i = v } := by
      intro v hv
      have hv_ghost : is_ghost_component_marked I u_lim v := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2
      exact u_lim.stable v hv_ghost
    have h_sum := Finset.sum_le_sum h_each_stab
    have h_const : (∑ v ∈ s_ghost, (3 : ℕ)) = 3 * s_ghost.card := by
      simp [Finset.sum_const, mul_comm]
    rw [hG']
    rwa [h_const] at h_sum
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib] at h_stab_le
  have h_fiber_card : (∑ v : u_lim.tree.V, Fintype.card { i : Fin k // u_lim.mark_vertex i = v }) = k := by
    have h_equiv := Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv u_lim.mark_vertex)
    rw [Fintype.card_sigma] at h_equiv
    rw [Fintype.card_fin] at h_equiv
    exact h_equiv
  have h_fiber_sub : (∑ v ∈ s_ghost, Fintype.card { i : Fin k // u_lim.mark_vertex i = v }) ≤ k := by
    have h_le := Finset.sum_le_univ_sum_of_nonneg (s := s_ghost) (f := fun v => Fintype.card { i : Fin k // u_lim.mark_vertex i = v })
      (fun _ => Nat.zero_le _)
    rwa [h_fiber_card] at h_le
  omega

docstring: $f_\lambda$ is smooth ($C^\infty$) at any point with non-zero denominator.
signature:
theorem contDiffAt_dil_fun (l : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) (hD : D_val l (v 2) ≠ 0) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (dil_fun l) v
goal_type:
∀ (l : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)),
  GromovCompactness.D_val l (v 2) ≠ 0 → ContDiffAt ℝ (↑⊤) (GromovCompactness.dil_fun l) v
proof:
by
  let E := EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ
  have h_eq : dil_fun l = E.symm ∘ (E ∘ dil_fun l) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rw [h_eq]
  apply ContDiff.comp_contDiffAt v E.symm.contDiff
  rw [contDiffAt_pi]
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · -- coordinate 0
    change ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => (2 * l * x 0) / D_val l (x 2)) v
    apply ContDiffAt.div
    · exact contDiffAt_const.mul (contDiffAt_euclidean_coord 0 v)
    · dsimp [D_val]

    · dsimp [D_val]
      exact contDiffAt_const.add (contDiffAt_const.mul (contDiffAt_euclidean_coord 2 v))
    · exact hD
  · -- coordinate 2
    change ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => ((1 - l^2) + (1 + l^2) * x 2) / D_val l (x 2)) v
    apply ContDiffAt.div
    · exact contDiffAt_const.add (contDiffAt_const.mul (contDiffAt_euclidean_coord 2 v))
    · dsimp [D_val]

docstring:
Finite difference quotients commute with the Cauchy-Riemann operator:
$\bar\partial(\Delta_{h, v} f)(z) = \Delta_{h, v}(\bar\partial f)(z)$.

theorem cauchyRiemann_differenceQuotient (f : ℂ → ℂ) (v : ℂ) (h : ℝ) (z : ℂ)
    (hf_z : DifferentiableAt ℝ f z)
    (hf_zh : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (z + (h : ℂ) * v)) :
    cauchyRiemann (fun w => differenceQuotient f v h w) z =
      differenceQuotient (cauchyRiemann f) v h z
goal_type:
∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (v : ℂ) (h : ℝ) (z : ℂ),
  DifferentiableAt ℝ f z →
    DifferentiableAt ℝ f (z + ↑h * v) →
      GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann (fun w => GromovCompactness.Analysis.differenceQuotient f v h w) z =
        GromovCompactness.Analysis.differenceQuotient (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f) v h z

  dsimp [differenceQuotient]

    have h_comp : (fun w => f (w + a)) = f ∘ (fun w => w + a) := rfl
    rw [h_comp]
    apply DifferentiableAt.comp z hf_zh
    exact differentiableAt_id.add_const a

    h_trans_diff.sub hf_z

  rw [h1]
  have h2 : cauchyRiemann (fun w => f (w + a) - f w) z =

theorem dil_fun_norm (l : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hD : D_val l (v 2) ≠ 0) : ‖dil_fun l v‖ = 1

  ‖v‖ = 1 → GromovCompactness.D_val l (v 2) ≠ 0 → ‖GromovCompactness.dil_fun l v‖ = 1
proof:
by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq] at hv ⊢
  have h_sum : (v 0)^2 + (v 1)^2 + (v 2)^2 = 1 := by
    have h_sq := congr_arg (fun x => x^2) hv
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at h_sq
    have h_pos : 0 ≤ ‖v 0‖ ^ 2 + ‖v 1‖ ^ 2 + ‖v 2‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt h_pos] at h_sq
    have h_norm_sq (x : ℝ) : ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x ^ 2 := by simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    rw [h_norm_sq, h_norm_sq, h_norm_sq] at h_sq
    norm_num at h_sq
    exact h_sq
  have h_dil_sum := dil_fun_norm_sq l v h_sum hD
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have h_norm_sq (x : ℝ) : ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x ^ 2 := by simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  rw [h_norm_sq, h_norm_sq, h_norm_sq]
  rw [h_dil_sum]
  exact Real.sqrt_one

name: test_A10_inner_boundary_collar_bounded_below
docstring:
In Iteration 1, the collar factor `(r₁ / R)^a` collapsed to 0 as `r₁ → 0`.
In the remediated contract, the factor is `((r / r₁)^a + (r₂ / R)^a)`.
We prove that for sub-annuli adjoining either the inner collar ($r_1 \le 2r$)
or the outer collar ($r_2 \ge R/2$), the decay factor is bounded below by a positive constant,
and in fact is strictly positive everywhere.

    (hr : 0 < r) (hr₁ : r < r₁) (hr₁_collar : r₁ ≤ 2 * r)
    (hr₂ : r₁ < r₂) (hr₂R : r₂ < R) :
    (1 / 2)^a_decay ≤ (r / r₁)^a_decay + (r₂ / R)^a_decay
goal_type:

    (hr₂ : r₁ < r₂) (hr₂R : r₂ < R) :

    have : 0 ≤ r₂ / R := div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
    positivity

name: challenge_two_atom_dirac_sum_evaluation
docstring:
Challenge 3.8 (Adversarial Multi-Atom Evaluation): Independent evaluation
on a 2-point atom set without cross-talk.
signature:
theorem challenge_two_atom_dirac_sum_evaluation
    (p q : CP1) (hpq : p ≠ q) (m_p m_q : ℝ) :
    let S : Finset CP1
goal_type:
theorem challenge_two_atom_dirac_sum_evaluation
    (p q : CP1) (hpq : p ≠ q) (m_p m_q : ℝ) :
    let S : Finset CP1
proof:
{p, q}
    let m : CP1 → ℝ := fun x => if x = p then m_p else m_q
    (∑ x ∈ S, (ENNReal.ofReal (m x) • Measure.dirac x)) {p} = ENNReal.ofReal m_p ∧
    (∑ x ∈ S, (ENNReal.ofReal (m x) • Measure.dirac x)) {q} = ENNReal.ofReal m_q := by
  intro S m
  have hp : p ∈ S := Finset.mem_insert_self p {q}
  have hq : q ∈ S := by
    rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    right; rfl
  have hm_p : m p = m_p := if_pos rfl
  have hm_q : m q = m_q := if_neg (Ne.symm hpq)
  constructor
  · rw [dirac_sum_singleton_mem S m p hp, hm_p]
  · rw [dirac_sum_singleton_mem S m q hq, hm_q]

For constant bubbles, the child defect set has at least one defect inside the unit disk
and at least one defect outside the unit disk.
signature:

    (thresh : TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : ℝ) (base_val : M)
    (decomp : OneLevelDecomposition I thresh m_defect base_val)
    (hm : thresh.h ≤ m_defect)
    (h_const_en : totalEnergy I decomp.v = 0)
    (h_const_disk : energyMeasure I decomp.v (disk_at 0 1) = 0) :
    (decomp.q.filter (fun w => ‖w‖ < 1)).Nonempty ∧
    (decomp.q.filter (fun w => ¬ (‖w‖ < 1))).Nonempty

    (thresh : TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : ℝ) (base_val : M)

    (hm : thresh.h ≤ m_defect)
    (h_const_en : totalEnergy I decomp.v = 0)
    (h_const_disk : energyMeasure I decomp.v (disk_at 0 1) = 0) :
    (decomp.q.filter (fun w => ‖w‖ < 1)).Nonempty ∧
    (decomp.q.filter (fun w => ¬ (‖w‖ < 1))).Nonempty
proof:
by
  let q_in := decomp.q.filter (fun w => ‖w‖ < 1)
  let q_out := decomp.q.filter (fun w => ¬ (‖w‖ < 1))
  have h_out_mass := decomp.ghost_outside_unit_disk_mass I thresh m_defect base_val h_const_en h_const_disk
  have h_out_pos : 0 < thresh.h / 2 := half_pos thresh.h_pos
  have h_out_ne : q_out.Nonempty := by
    by_contra h_empty
    rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty, not_not] at h_empty
    have h_zero : (∑ z ∈ q_out, decomp.m_child z) = 0 := by rw [h_empty, Finset.sum_empty]
    linarith [h_out_mass, h_out_pos, h_zero]
  have h_calib := decomp.calibrated_unit_mass
  rw [h_const_disk, zero_add] at h_calib
  have h_in_pos : 0 < m_defect - thresh.h / 2 := by linarith [thresh.h_pos, hm]
  have h_in_ne : q_in.Nonempty := by
    by_contra h_empty
    rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty, not_not] at h_empty
    have h_zero : (∑ z ∈ q_in, decomp.m_child z) = 0 := by rw [h_empty, Finset.sum_empty]
    linarith [h_calib, h_in_pos, h_zero]
  exact ⟨h_in_ne, h_out_ne⟩

name: probe_no_degenerate_zero_J
docstring:
Adversarial Probe 1.2: A degenerate operator satisfying $J^2 = \mathrm{id}$ or $J = 0$
cannot satisfy the AlmostComplexStructure condition for non-zero vectors.
signature:
theorem probe_no_degenerate_zero_J
    (vJ : VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I (M := M))
    (n : ℕ) (x : M) (v : TangentSpace I x) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    vJ.J_seq n x v ≠ 0
goal_type:
theorem probe_no_degenerate_zero_J
    (vJ : VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I (M := M))
    (n : ℕ) (x : M) (v : TangentSpace I x) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    vJ.J_seq n x v ≠ 0
proof:
by
  intro h_zero
  have h_sq := vJ.J_seq_sq n x v
  have h_map_zero : vJ.J_seq n x (vJ.J_seq n x v) = 0 := by
    rw [h_zero, ContinuousLinearMap.map_zero]
  rw [h_map_zero] at h_sq
  have h_v_zero : v = 0 := by
    calc v = -(-v) := (neg_neg v).symm
         _ = -0 := by rw [← h_sq]
         _ = 0 := neg_zero
  exact hv h_v_zero

proof:

  have h_bound := marked_ghost_components_bound I u_lim P G h_multi hP hG
  have h_split : Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V = G + P := by
    let s_prin := Finset.univ.filter (is_principal_component_marked I u_lim)

      rw [h_prin_eq, Finset.filter_card_add_filter_neg_card_eq_card, Finset.card_univ]
